text:
nina-partnerships: Quick FYI from partners: several marketplace vendors asked about the batch response envelope change (we're removing `items[]` wrapper). They need a recommended compatibility approach and partner-facing timelines.

raj-sdks: We should support a dual-envelope mode for one release cycle: accept both `{items: [...]}` and `[...]`, and emit headers indicating chosen format. That buys partners time.

carmen-eng: Agree. Implementation plan: 1) read both shapes, 2) add response header `Rw-Resp-Format: legacy|array`, 3) feature flag `partners/batch_envelope_v2`.

eli-hw: Hardware integrators prefer explicit opt-in for new format. They want us to sign off on a QA date before we flip enforcement. Recommend 120d opt-in.

tess-ops: Ops: we can gate by partner-id in the feature flag store. Want a rollout checklist: smoke tests, error-rate monitor, rollback window.

frank-gpm: From a marketplace listing POV we need copy that explains behavior, e.g., "Clients may receive either legacy or compact batch envelopes during migration" and an ETA. Also schedule a partner webinar.

raj-sdks: Small code sample for partner docs (to include in migration guide):

```
# handle both shapes
resp = client.call(...) 
if isinstance(resp, list):
  items = resp
else:
  items = resp.get('items', [])
```

And example to opt-in via partner-level flag: `rw.flags.set('partners/1234', 'batch_envelope_v2', true)`.

carmen-eng: We'll also emit an `Rw-Compat` request header that partners can set to force legacy or v2 behavior for testing: `Rw-Compat: envelope=legacy|v2`. Routing will honor that ahead of flags if present.

eli-hw: Can we also produce a certification artifact when a partner completes validation? E.g., `compat-cert: batch-envelope-v2;issued=2026-06-15`. That helps marketplace listings show "certified".

tess-ops: We'll add a step in the ops playbook to produce a signed cert blob (S3 URL) after successful canary. Need legal to vet the wording.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Created task #7890: add dual-envelope parsing tests + header emission in `rw-runtime` and a feature-flag namespace `partners/envelope_migration`.

frank-gpm: Timeline proposal: announce -> 90d opt-in for HW/SI -> 45d for ISVs -> 30d canary -> enforce after partner opt-outs processed. Publish tentative dates on partner portal and marketplace.

nina-partnerships: Action list: Raj -> write migration guide & code samples; Carmen -> PR for header/flag support + tests; Eli -> confirm cert process and preferred dates with HW PMs; Tess -> add ops checklist & monitoring thresholds; Frank -> draft partner comms and webinar invite; I'll coordinate legal review. Target to publish draft timeline Friday.

raj-sdks: Will add a small SDK helper `response.normalize_batch(resp)` and document it in the guide.

carmen-eng: I'll open the PR and tag `ops` and `partners` for review. Expecting initial tests tomorrow.

nina-partnerships: Great. Please report any change requests here so we can keep partner-facing timeline accurate. :white_check_mark:
